cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Affectionate Resentment
cards.instruction: Remain warm and familiar while letting old resentment sharpen beneath every caring gesture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Here's your tea, love. Exactly right, even without a birthday reminder.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've brought cake. A month late, I know.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Your favourite, too. I'll warm your plate; I've kept the candle ready.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Put it in. I'll sing now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come closer, love. I'll shield the flame. We don't want it stopping halfway through like last year's birthday call.

mechanism: A offers affectionate birthday care while grading its pupil belated apology against remembered failures.
confusable: Not simple cruelty: tea, warm plate and protected candle are real care, each edged with a teaching correction.
comparison: Birthday hosting versus warming a waiting partner.
seedUse: D93 tea/cake/candle/cutoff call; S05 models and grades consideration.
